transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well... I suppose I'm here about the house. The kitchen, really. 

It's... it's been nearly two years now. The contractor and a few people on our block... they've been quietly working together. To cheat us. They're keeping the kitchen half-wrong on purpose. My husband keeps showing me receipts, and they all have their little excuses, but... well. I know what's going on. That's why I'm here, I guess.
Do you believe that people are trying to harm you or trick you in any other ways besides what you've described with the kitchen?
No... I don't think so. Just the kitchen. That's... well, that's enough to deal with, really. I haven't noticed anything else.
Do you have any beliefs or concerns that others might consider unusual or not based in reality, aside from what you've already mentioned about the kitchen?
I... no. I don't think so. I mean, I told you about the kitchen. That's... that's all there is to it. I don't know what else you're looking for.
Have you ever heard voices or sounds that others around you don't seem to hear?
No. I haven't heard anything like that. Just... normal sounds.
Have you ever seen or felt things that others around you don't seem to notice?
No... I haven't seen anything. I don't feel anything strange either. Just what I told you before.
Do you ever have thoughts or beliefs that you know other people might find strange or hard to believe, even if they don't seem to affect your daily life much?
No... I don't. I just... I live quietly. I don't have a bunch of strange ideas in my head. I already explained the situation to you, and... well, there really isn't anything else to say about it.
How strongly do you believe that the contractor and people on your block are working together to keep your kitchen half-wrong on purpose?

I'm... I'm sure of it. I've been sure for nearly two years now. 

They're quietly working together to cheat us. Just... keeping the kitchen half-wrong on purpose. My husband, he keeps showing me receipts, and they give all these excuses, but... I know what's happening. That's why I'm here.
Even though your husband has shown you receipts and the contractor has given explanations, do you still feel certain that they are trying to cheat you with the kitchen?

Yes. I... I thought I just said that. 

It doesn't matter how many pieces of paper my husband pulls out, or... or what excuses they come up with. The receipts don't change anything. I know they're doing it on purpose. It's been nearly two years of them keeping it half-finished just to cheat us. So... yes, I'm certain.
Have you ever considered that your belief about the contractor and neighbors working together to ruin your kitchen might not be accurate, even for a moment?

No. I haven't. 

I know what I know. It's been two years of this... this whole thing with the kitchen. They're working together to cheat us. I don't need to second-guess myself just because they have excuses.
